g.text: Data model: requests, workflow routes and the event log

text.tspan: request_events is append-only (trigger 0002 + ORM guard), unique (request_id, seq); its rows rebuild the credit_requests projection.
stage_routes: unique (stage_id, min_amount); bands [min_amount, max_amount) cover every amount for each stage.
Outside this diagram: credit_requests.client_id → clients.id, request_events.actor_user_id → users.id (data-model-users).
